_comment: Single source of truth for the tab snapshot/patch wire contract. Edit this file and run `make bridge-gen` to regenerate. See scripts/generate_bridge_protocol.mjs.

fields.name: url
fields._comment: Swift sends empty string when nil; TS coerces to empty string (non-optional).

fields.name: customTitle
fields._comment: Pinned and bookmarked tabs: the user's name for the tab, shown instead of the title; empty when unnamed.

fields.name: homeTitle
fields._comment: Pinned and bookmarked tabs away from their home page: that page's title; empty at home and for other tabs.

fields.name: hasPopup
fields._comment: A page popup opened by this tab is still open.

fields.name: spaceId
fields._comment: Swift omits if nil.

fields.name: faviconDataURL
fields._comment: Excluded from runtimePatchData. Swift sends empty string when nil; TS coerces to undefined when empty.

fields.name: faviconDominantColor
fields._comment: Excluded from runtimePatchData. Swift sends empty string when nil; TS validates hex format (empty coerces to undefined).

fields.name: pageColor
fields._comment: Web tabs: the solid color along the page's top edge, else hex stops read off that edge from left to right, comma-separated, else its theme-color; empty when unknown. The bars over the page take it.

fields.name: isNotSecure
fields._comment: Web tabs: an https page whose certificate the user let through, or that loaded part of its content over http.

fields.name: kind
fields._comment: "web", "terminal" or "changes" (the diff of the repository at cwd).

fields.name: cwd
fields._comment: Terminal tabs only: the shell's working directory.

fields.name: gitBranch
fields._comment: Terminal tabs only: the branch checked out in the working directory's repository, or a short commit when detached.

fields.name: diffAdded
fields._comment: Terminal tabs only: lines added in the repository against HEAD, untracked files included.

fields.name: diffRemoved
fields._comment: Terminal tabs only: lines removed in the repository against HEAD.

fields.name: terminalState
fields._comment: Terminal tabs only: idle, busy (running and printing), waiting (running, quiet), succeeded, failed or exited.

fields.name: terminalCommand
fields._comment: Terminal tabs only: the running command line, or the last one.

fields.name: terminalStartedAt
fields._comment: Terminal tabs only: when the running command started, in milliseconds since 1970; 0 when none runs.

fields.name: terminalExitCode
fields._comment: Terminal tabs only: exit code of the last command.

fields.name: terminalDuration
fields._comment: Terminal tabs only: how long the last command took, in seconds.

fields.name: hasUnreadOutput
fields._comment: Terminal tabs only: output or a bell arrived while the tab was in the background.

fields.name: hasUnreadNotification
fields._comment: Web tabs only: the page posted a notification while the tab was not shown.

fields.name: awaitingInputSince
fields._comment: When a terminal's running program rang the bell or asked for a notification with no input since, as an agent does when it waits for an answer, or a web page raised a dialog held until its tab shows, in milliseconds since 1970; 0 when it waits for nothing.
